runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies to new AI contracts 180 days after the memorandum is issued. The memo's section on future contracts says it shall apply to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum. The same 180-day trigger also covers any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract.

The memo is dated April 2025 and the passages don't give an exact calendar date, so I can't say which day the 180-day window ends. The memo also excludes AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.

support.reason: Passage states the memorandum applies to contracts awarded from solicitations issued on or after 180 days after issuance.
Passage explicitly says the memorandum applies to options to renew or extend exercised on existing contracts after the 180-day date.
Passage states the memorandum does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
